_comment: Root architecture gate for THIS repo (a library of skills + offline gate scripts). The built-in error-handling checks (emptyCatch/swallowReturn/keepInSync) are left OFF here on purpose: the gate scripts use deliberate best-effort catches, and .claude/skills/judge-arch/assets/discriminate-fixtures holds intentionally-bad code used by the mutation test. Those built-ins belong in an adopter's application config (they are ON in the presets under .claude/skills/judge-arch/assets/presets). What this root gate enforces is what is true and valuable for this repo: house style and script hygiene. house-style-no-em-dash now scans ALL skill docs, scripts, scenarios, and configs plus the front-door files via globs (ADR-0033), so a dash anywhere in scope fails the gate rather than relying on a per-file ratchet. The vendor dir, discriminate-fixtures, and app-managed worktrees are ignored.

rules.name: house-style-no-em-dash
rules.message: House style: no em or en dashes in prose. Use a period, a comma, or parentheses. Add a skill's path here once it is rewritten clean.

rules.name: no-outbound-web-in-gate-scripts
rules.message: Gate and checker scripts are offline CLI tools; they must not make outbound web calls.
